description.narrative:
Despite the justice reform introduced in 2016, the Albanian Constitutional Court continues to face several challenges that hinder its efficiency and transparency. The paper-based case management system remains a significant bottleneck, posing challenges for the Court to manage its increasing caseload. The backlog of cases, places substantial pressure on the Court's resources, which are further strained by the growing complexity of constitutional complaints. In addition to operational challenges, there is a need for improved access to case law and methodological support for legal advisors and judges. Furthermore, the Court's ability to provide adequate capacity building for its staff and foster knowledge-sharing is also constrained by outdated systems and procedures.
Digitalization of the case management system and the creation of an integrated research and documentation framework are essential to addressing these challenges. A modern case management system, combined with enhanced legal research tools, would not only streamline internal processes but also strengthen the Courts transparency and accountability, including through the analysis of disaggregated data on gender and other vulnerable groups. This will help enhance the Courts responsiveness to public concerns and improve public trust in its decisions. Providing access to European Court case-law will improve legal reasoning and consistency, contributing to a further alignment of Albanias constitutional justice system with European human rights standards. The project aims to address these gaps, ensuring the sustainability and effectiveness of constitutional justice in Albania.
On impact level, the development goal of the interventions is Enhanced efficiency, transparency, and adherence to European Court standards in the work of the Constitutional Court of Albania.
On intermediate outcome level the goals are:
1) Improved operational capacity and efficiency of the Albanian Constitutional Court.
2) Consistency in the application of European Court standards by the Constitutional Court in Albania.
On immediate outcome level, the objectives of the intervention stand as:
1.1. Enhanced digitalization and automation of case management systems within the Constitutional Court.
2.1. Strengthened and gender-sensitive research and methodological capacity of the Constitutional Courts Research Department.
